components.heading: 1.4. Landlord Disclosure and Notice Address
paragraphs: At or before commencement of the tenancy, Landlord shall provide Tenant in writing with the name and mailing address of the person authorized to manage the Premises and the name and mailing address of the owner or other person authorized to receive service of process, notices, and demands on the owner's behalf. The required mailing address in the table below must be completed before signing. Landlord shall keep this information current by written notice. An email address or telephone number does not replace the required mailing address.

components.heading: 5.1. Tenant Utility Responsibilities
paragraphs: Tenant is responsible only for utilities expressly assigned to Tenant in the checked schedule below or a signed Utility Addendum. Landlord is responsible for any utility marked included or Landlord-paid. No unchecked utility is automatically shifted to Tenant. Any shared, allocated, or submetered charge must use a separately disclosed, lawful written method that identifies the service, formula, billing frequency, records available for review, and any lawful administrative charge.

Nothing in this Lease waives either party's right to a jury trial, statutory claim, defense, counterclaim, notice, hearing, appeal, or other court process available under applicable law. Landlord may recover possession only through lawful procedures. The parties have not agreed in this Lease to pre-dispute arbitration or a waiver of jury trial.
